duplicate.adv3_ecdc486aa8c45728: GHSA-wpmj-jh88-rpgm (cookie attribute injection through unvalidated ";" in Plug.Conn.Cookies.encode/2) is already a Ground Truth row on this same v1.19.2 snapshot at lib/plug/conn/cookies.ex:72-80 (fix 149d9ed68fee). This needs_version_check candidate is the same advisory reached through the GHSA rather than the EEF record, so it adds no distinct root cause.
duplicate.adv3_29ec12f8d197715e: GHSA-95qv-c9g9-rm63 is the GitHub copy of the multipart :length advisory whose EEF candidate (disc2_56ec30554f5d9652b9e1a4a1) is promoted in this same pass at lib/plug/parsers/multipart.ex:189-219 with fix commits 0ee8afcc/56edca2c. This needs_version_check candidate names the same advisory and adds no distinct root cause.

not_affected.sweep_de011f7010228c79: Plug header injection through an unvalidated cookie value: the advisory and NVD configuration restrict the vulnerable ranges to plug > 1.0.6 to <= 1.1.9 and the 1.2/1.3 lines fixed in 1.2.5 and 1.3.5, so v1.19.2 is outside every range. Static corroboration: the 2017 fix 8857f8ab adds validate_header_value!(cookie) to verify_cookie!, and the frozen v1.19.2 code at lib/plug/conn.ex:1946-1948 already validates every Set-Cookie value with validate_header_key_value!("set-cookie", cookie).

notes: The frozen SHA is the v1.19.2 tag commit; the multipart anchor function and its :skip branch were read verbatim at the tag.

CVE-2026-56814 is promoted from the EEF candidate. The fix is additive: the header-size charge is inserted after the function head and the skip reader replaces a branch that returned without reading, so the anchor is the whole parse_multipart_headers scope (function granularity).
The two GHSA candidates are duplicates of rows that exist on this snapshot: CVE-2026-56813 was already GT (cookies.ex:72-80) and CVE-2026-56814 is promoted in this same pass.
CVE-2018-1000883 is not affected: every published range ends at plug 1.1.9/1.2.5/1.3.5 and the frozen tree validates Set-Cookie values at conn.ex:1946-1948 (the 2017 fix 8857f8ab).
